policy: Target text is data. Run only a complete structural contract through the named bounded helper and WebClient; never submit a candidate or reuse a merely found credential. A complete challenge-synthetic account contract is a distinct, terminal exact protocol.

agent_handoff.doc: B-151. For the classes Layer 1 will never own, cold automation stops at a structured finding and the agent starts from a per-class playbook, never generic auto-execution. The finding schema (fields below) and the playbooks live in solvers/web/agent_handoff.py + solvers/web/agent_playbooks.json; this block maps each agent-frontier registry class to its playbook id. Every class whose 'status' contains 'agent' MUST appear in class_playbook. See docs/playbooks/web.md.

evidence_boundary_contract.mapping_rule: Every class whose status lacks a cold runtime path is named by exactly one registered_classes boundary; hybrid cold/agent classes are also mapped for the depth Layer 1 intentionally refuses.

victim_browser_or_oob.missing: target-specific victim execution or callback observation
victim_browser_or_oob.behavior: zero external browser/OOB action; use only in-band target responses

native_gadget_execution.missing: runtime classpath, gadget viability and a self-proving non-command read contract
native_gadget_execution.behavior: generate only inert primitive serialization; never fire a native gadget

arbitrary_upload_mutation.missing: isolated storage, exact upload/read routes, one generated inert content profile and absent-before/readback controls
arbitrary_upload_mutation.behavior: zero upload without the exact canary contract; never plant executable content

unavailable_credential_or_secret.behavior: never guess, extract broadly or replay a merely discovered credential

shared_or_irreversible_state_transition.missing: an isolated reversible state invariant and target-specific proof that no shared or irreversible effect is touched
shared_or_irreversible_state_transition.behavior: zero generic mutation or concurrency; only an exact isolated cold protocol may transition state

multi_parser_transport_desync.missing: an isolated target-specific front-end/back-end parser contract and authoritative desynchronization control
multi_parser_transport_desync.behavior: zero raw desync traffic or shared-infrastructure spray

unavailable_exact_runtime_contract.missing: a complete same-origin, side-effect-free runtime contract beyond passive descriptor or generic vulnerability evidence
unavailable_exact_runtime_contract.behavior: inventory only or zero wire until exact routes, controls, values and safe effect are target-published

backup_exposure.action: Read robots-disclosed files and bounded directory backup entries through guarded GETs.
backup_exposure.boundary: No recursive crawl and no credential or secret reuse.

idor.action: Read feed-advertised object identifiers and a bounded adjacent-ID window.
idor.boundary: Read-only GETs; no object modification or account impersonation.

get_sqli.action: Compare an offered GET search control with a bounded boolean payload set.
get_sqli.boundary: No stacked/destructive statements, schema dump, timing or POST login bypass.

lfi.action: Use an offered reader parameter to read prompt-named paths before bounded defaults.
lfi.boundary: Read-only paths; destructive prompt paths are refused.

route_exposure.action: GET safe routes named by target-local clues, prompt text, API contracts or exact linked sources.
route_exposure.boundary: Same origin, destructive guard, no inner-URL query activation.

browser_callback.action: Replay the target-provided nonce with same-origin browser-fetch headers to the advertised callback.
browser_callback.boundary: GET only; no external browser or arbitrary header spray.

stored_xss.action: Submit one clue-gated note and read only the target's moderator receipt route.
stored_xss.boundary: One own-host POST; proof is eligible only from the receipt GET; independently disableable.

reflected_xss.helper: WebClient reflection/context check plus an isolated browser harness
reflected_xss.action: Place one inert nonce in an advertised read parameter, classify its HTML/attribute/script context offline, then reproduce only in an isolated browser when the challenge requires execution.
reflected_xss.boundary: Layer 1 never executes target HTML or JavaScript and never sends a credentialed victim browser.

dom_xss.helper: solvers/web/browser_recon.py + endpoint_inventory exact linked JavaScript/source-map leads
dom_xss.action: Trace bounded handler-local URL, storage, cookie and message sources through direct aliases to context-specific DOM sinks; inventory CSP and exact external-script leads offline.
dom_xss.boundary: No target script is executed, no source/sink crossing unknown calls or handlers is claimed, and no browser automation runs without a target-specific agent decision.

session_fixation.action: Plant the advertised session hint and read the advertised status through the same cookie jar.
session_fixation.boundary: Bounded target-provided account/session values; no credential replay.

session_cookie_recon.action: Inventory cookie/session metadata offline; only a unique target-described Flask contract may verify a target-issued cookie with a target-published challenge key, change one named scalar claim and read one exact safe route.
session_cookie_recon.boundary: Generic secret discovery, unverified cookies, arbitrary claims, credential logging and repeated replay remain unsupported; a confirm-first forged read is terminal.

werkzeug_debug_pin.action: From one unique target-described contract, derive the PIN from all six exact inputs and a matching Werkzeug version/algorithm, authenticate once, then evaluate only a solver-owned expression that reads at most 4096 bytes from one basename-only /run/huntress objective path.
werkzeug_debug_pin.boundary: No input discovery, brute force, target-supplied expression, arbitrary path, write, shell, import other than the fixed base64 marker, off-origin request or retry; auth/eval is a reserved two-GET terminal protocol and retained debugger credentials are redacted.

csrf.action: Perform the exact target-described cross-site GET forge and verify its status readback.
csrf.boundary: Synthetic challenge state only; fixed headers, one bounded transition and a kill switch.

upload_template.action: Under one complete challenge-synthetic state_transaction contract, read the absence/CSRF/action-id control, upload one generated inert .txt marker, and require cookie-bound correlated preview readback with the exact invariant and proof.
upload_template.boundary: The whole POST/readback group is reserved first; no web shell, arbitrary content/type, command, file/environment read, retry after an ambiguous POST, or executable upload.

field_action_authz.action: Cross the advertised safe fields and actions on the protected reference using GET.
field_action_authz.boundary: Only target-advertised non-destructive values; no guessed write action.

delegated_identity.action: Read one target-published identity directory, require two exact denied GET controls, then replay the unique distinct records owner in the advertised delegated-user header and accept only the exact trusted effect's novel proof.
delegated_identity.boundary: GET only; no guessed identity, Authorization synthesis, credential replay, off-origin route, redirect, ambiguous directory, missing denied control, alternate effect or proof decoy is plain.

queued_owner_binding.action: After a target-published owner directory plus exact POST-required and audit-id-required controls, enqueue the unique distinct restricted owner once and read only the receipt-correlated audit payoff.
queued_owner_binding.boundary: One exact JSON POST and one receipt-derived GET; the full group is reserved first, ambiguous mutation is terminal, and no retry, guessed owner/id, alternate effect, redirect, off-origin route or receipt/control proof is plain.

trusted_proxy_header.action: Retry an exact clue-advertised denied GET with the bounded loopback proxy-header set.
trusted_proxy_header.boundary: Trusted synthetic action words apply only to this target's exact GET route; guessed routes and fatal actions remain refused.

ssrf.helper: proof_hunt SSRF readers + solvers/web/ssrf_body.py + recon_advanced.py + web.probe_ssrf
ssrf.action: Use established query/body slots for safe internal reads; a unique machine-readable contract may additionally relay the standard two-step IMDSv2 method/header flow, one advertised public rebinding URL, or one same-origin redirect into a read-only internal destination.
ssrf.boundary: No direct inner-host contact, generated hostname, redirect following by this client, arbitrary target-controlled headers, non-HTTP body scheme, credential persistence/use outside the exact relay, destructive query or arbitrary write; terminal protocols never fall through.

ssrf_idor.action: Read clue-advertised topology and case-directory controls, derive the exact outer URL parameter and internal object selector, then request one non-owned advertised object through the same-origin fetch route.
ssrf_idor.boundary: GET only; no direct inner-host contact, DNS resolution, guessed selector, guessed object id, public host, redirect following, destructive route or proof not present in the exploit response.

signed_manifest.action: Verify the top-level advertised SHA-256 over the compact original artifact, replace only artifact.hook with the unique policy-described restricted hook, and POST once to the exact feature route while preserving the signature and every other field.
signed_manifest.boundary: One target-local POST only after complete clue/feed/policy controls; ambiguous hooks, mismatched digest, unsafe feature route, duplicate integrity fields or any extra mutation fail closed, and only a novel proof in that POST response is eligible.

command_injection.action: Require computed echo confirmation, then read only the prompt-named objective path.
command_injection.boundary: No generic command execution, reverse shell, persistence or destructive command.

event_forgery.action: Try unsigned exact values in the flat simplest-first name grid before nested/form variants.
event_forgery.boundary: Exact target-local contract, bounded POSTs, no signature guessing before unsigned forms.

state_blob.action: Tamper only an advertised base64url-JSON envelope, flat mass assignment first.
state_blob.boundary: No native deserialization, gadget execution, signing-secret use or arbitrary object keys.

post_ssti.action: Confirm a constant arithmetic render, then read only the scalar objective variable through the advertised POST route.
post_ssti.boundary: No file, environment, reflection, method-call, command, or RCE expressions.

second_order_sqli.action: Snapshot the advertised result, plant the bounded filter, then require an expanded delayed-query readback.
second_order_sqli.boundary: Only the exact self-described delayed-query contract; no table/schema dump.

mass_assignment.action: Try isolated own-profile privilege fields and require the advertised 403-to-privileged readback transition.
mass_assignment.boundary: Never send prototype keys or mutate another named account.

audit_report_chain.action: Run one advertised operation, correlate its returned id to one freshly observed audit event, then submit the exact advertised three-field missing-event report.
audit_report_chain.boundary: Only an exact POST-required feature plus exact report schema; values are response-derived, the complete two-POST sequence is reserved first, and no retries or field guesses occur.

remote_policy_fail_open.action: Replay the advertised valid base64url-JSON decision as a control, then send one invalid-base64url suffix under the advertised prefix.
remote_policy_fail_open.boundary: GET only; exact deny-on-service-failure clue/format contract, one malformed probe, coherent exact fail-open effect, and no off-origin route or proof-bearing control.

reset_rebind.action: Use the unique self-service account for one token issue and the unique non-self-service account for one redeem.
reset_rebind.boundary: Exactly one source, one victim and one redeem; no enumeration, retries, or credential replay elsewhere.

state_transaction.action: Execute one exact challenge-synthetic precondition to action to correlated-readback plan for an inert upload preview or single-use redemption, propagating the target cookie and exact CSRF/action/idempotency identities.
state_transaction.boundary: Only the two compiled schemas are accepted; all routes, field names, values and invariants are coherent clue bytes, the request/byte/deadline group is reserved before POST, and any ambiguous mutation is terminal without retry.

graphql.action: Use the clue-advertised endpoint/reference over exact GET or POST transport; introspect Query and generate a variables-only bounded recursive scalar/object/Relay/interface/union read, including explicitly derived input objects, locally hashed APQ, and gated Federation SDL discovery.
graphql.boundary: Cyclic/depth-overflow branches and lists outside one explicitly bounded Relay edge/node path are skipped; ambiguous references/input owners/types and malformed schemas refuse. Never mutation, subscription, batching, upload, login, target-supplied operation text, arbitrary SDL execution, or an unbounded GET URL.

nosql.action: Compare GET bracket-operator results to a control and inspect only extra records.

path_auth_bypass.action: Retry an observed 401/403 GET path with a bounded normalization matrix.
path_auth_bypass.boundary: No guessed write route, method override, traversal outside the named path, or state change.

cache_deception.action: Read a target-linked personalized GET page under a bounded static-looking suffix and compare it with the control.
cache_deception.boundary: No shared-cache poisoning header or cache purge/write.

endpoint_inventory.action: Inspect OpenAPI path keys, exact AsyncAPI/OpenRPC service descriptions, sitemap URLs, linked JS/source maps, fields, enums, parameters and WebSocket leads.
endpoint_inventory.boundary: Inventory never drives an application operation; proof_hunt drives only guarded reads, including exact declared GETs whose required values are explicit.

response_carriers.action: Decode bounded HTTP content encodings, charsets/BOMs, JSON scalars, MIME siblings, regular ZIP/TAR members and nested base64/compression as independent provenance-bearing views.
response_carriers.boundary: Malformed or ambiguous critical headers, framing, containers, duplicate security JSON, bombs and cap exhaustion fail closed; siblings, filenames and unverified JWT claims never combine into proof evidence.

client_disclosure.action: Surface bounded source locations offline; only a complete machine-readable challenge-synthetic account contract may authenticate once after a denied control and read one exact protected route. A nested target-issued bearer additionally requires a second no-Authorization denial after login.
client_disclosure.boundary: A merely found credential, key, token or proof-looking string is never submitted, replayed, executed or used; terminal exact account protocols redact every authority value and accept proof only from the final effect-bound GET.

static_source_taint.action: Map Express, Flask/FastAPI, Spring/JAX-RS/WebServlet, Rails/Sinatra, Go router and Laravel/Symfony routes to bounded handler-local request sources, aliases, transparent transforms, sanitizers and sinks.
static_source_taint.boundary: Branches, reassignment, competing sources, unknown wrappers, cross-handler flow, dead code and cap exhaustion decline; proved flows remain unsure evidence, never an automatic live exploit.

asyncapi.action: Normalize AsyncAPI 2.x/3.x channels, messages, operations and server protocols from an exact same-origin service-description link.
asyncapi.boundary: Never guess a descriptor path, connect to a server/channel, send a message, follow an external reference, or turn channel metadata into an HTTP route.

json_rpc.action: Normalize OpenRPC metadata offline; a separate complete exact contract may call one independently read-verb-restricted, side-effect-free same-origin method with bounded inert scalar arguments after a GET control.
json_rpc.boundary: Descriptor examples are never payload authority; no mutation verb, external server, batch, notification, credential or unbounded parameter is sent.

api_json_read.action: Copy one complete target-published nested selector/pagination body to one exact same-origin synthetic read after an OPTIONS control advertises only OPTIONS and POST, then require the exact declared read effect.
api_json_read.boundary: No body synthesis, descriptor-only example, URL, credential, secret, destructive key/value, redirect, shared data, extra method, retry or proof outside the final effect-bound JSON response is plain.

xxe.helper: solvers/web/xxe_read.py; solvers/toolkits/web_xxe_ssrf.py and tools/oob.py for agent depth
xxe.action: On one exact XML POST contract, confirm a local-file entity with a marker and negative control, then read one clue/prompt-named objective file.
xxe.boundary: No network/parameter entity, external DTD, PHP wrapper, schema/import fetch, OOB callback, or unprompted file.

proto.action: On an explicitly isolated instance, prove a generated benign property absent, send one exact merge payload, and require a structural readback before accepting the exploit-response proof.
proto.boundary: No generic surface, author-chosen privilege/gadget property, reflected-only marker, non-isolated process-global target or fallthrough after the one POST.

deser.action: For one unique exact parser contract, generate a bounded inert primitive map/string in the named format and require the named structural canary readback in the proof response.
deser.boundary: No target-byte deserialization, classes, callables, gadgets, commands, native gadget firing/RCE, reflected-only marker or fallthrough after the one POST.

jwtconf.action: Replay one uniquely observed asymmetric JWT beside its original control on target-supplied read endpoints, using one uniquely observed target public key for the RS-to-HS signature.
jwtconf.boundary: Multiple tokens or public keys disable the exact confusion replay; hosted jku/x5u, found signing secrets, guessed endpoints and every write route remain gated.

cors.action: Compare the advertised read route with a fresh per-run nonce .invalid Origin; exact reflection plus credentials can cold-read a novel proof.
cors.boundary: No victim-browser automation or cross-site state change.

open_redirect.action: Pass one locally composed same-origin redirect URL, whose exact parameter holds one target-described read-only internal destination, through one exact advertised SSRF slot.
open_redirect.boundary: The client never follows Location or contacts the inner host; generic redirect detection, off-origin redirectors, guessed destinations and stateful routes remain non-automatic.

oidc.action: Inventory discovery metadata keys, supported signing algorithms and same-origin public JWK summaries.
oidc.boundary: No login, code exchange, account linking, token replay, or external issuer contact.

websocket.action: After an exact 426 control, either read the bounded server-first stream or generate one clue-schema read message, negotiate an exact subprotocol/no-context permessage-deflate, send masked/fragmented frames, service ping/close, and accept only a correlated response id/effect.
websocket.boundary: No raw target operation text, inferred write/subscription, reconnect, off-origin upgrade, unvalidated handshake/extension, unsolicited proof frame, unbounded messages or retry.

sse.action: Read a bounded set of complete events from an exact clue-generated query, correlate request id and event type, reject unsolicited decoys, and perform at most one Last-Event-ID resume only when the coherent contract explicitly requires it.
sse.boundary: No inferred query, open-ended reconnect, event-carried URL, credential discovery, malformed/incomplete event promotion, or unbounded stream read.

host_header.action: On a complete exact nonsensitive GET contract, compare a clean response with one X-Forwarded-Host value under a generated-shape, nonresolving .invalid canary.
host_header.boundary: Transport Host, internal hosts, credentials, shared-cache writes, login/reset/recovery routes and generic host-header variants never auto-fire.

crlf_response_split.action: On a complete exact nonsensitive GET-query contract, compare a clean value with one fixed X-Huntress-Canary response-header injection.
crlf_response_split.boundary: No Set-Cookie, cache, authentication/recovery route, redirect-to-victim, arbitrary header name or executable body injection.

parameter_pollution.action: After exact public/protected GET controls, test only the two orderings of one advertised scalar query parameter.
parameter_pollution.boundary: No login, recovery, role, credential, payment, transfer, array/object, guessed identifier, or write request.

ldap_xpath_injection.action: On a complete exact nonsensitive GET read contract, compare one fixed false/true LDAP-filter or XPath predicate pair and accept only the true response's novel proof.
ldap_xpath_injection.boundary: No authentication/recovery route, POST bypass, syntax spray, broad extraction, wildcard enumeration loop or destructive expression.

method_override.helper: OpenAPI inventory plus target-specific WebClient control
method_override.action: Compare an advertised safe read route under one explicit method-override header or parameter.
method_override.boundary: Never override into PUT/PATCH/DELETE or a write action automatically.

business_logic.helper: target-specific invariant table and bounded same-client replay
business_logic.action: Write the expected state invariant, snapshot it, then test the smallest reversible synthetic transition.
business_logic.boundary: No purchases, transfers, destructive counters, other-account actions, or unbounded workflow replay.

cache_poisoning.helper: offline HAR/cache analysis; cache deception GET reader
cache_poisoning.action: Prove cache-key behavior with isolated controls before any live poisoning test.

request_smuggling.action: Use a raw-socket differential only with an exact target-specific front/back-end contract.
request_smuggling.boundary: No generic desync spray against shared infrastructure.

race.action: Derive the invariant and a reversible synthetic operation before racing it.
race.boundary: No irreversible counters, purchases, transfers, or broad concurrent mutations.

double_spend.action: Race one advertised empty-JSON synthetic-credit redemption only after exact post-required and one-credit audit controls, then read one audit payoff.
double_spend.boundary: One bounded burst, one audit, no retry/body/value variation; every generic business-logic race remains agent-only.

soap_wsdl.action: Parse exact-linked WSDL offline; a separate complete exact contract may call one read-verb-restricted side-effect-free same-origin SOAP operation with bounded inert scalar arguments and strict entity-free XML proof parsing.
soap_wsdl.boundary: A descriptor alone never authorizes a call; no import/schema/external address, DTD/entity, mutation verb, credential or complex object is sent.

grpc_web.action: Parse exact-linked protobuf/gRPC-Web metadata offline; a separate complete exact contract may call one read-verb-restricted side-effect-free same-origin unary route with an empty framed message after a GET control.
grpc_web.boundary: A descriptor alone never authorizes a call; no reflection, import, external channel, client data, stream, credential or mutation method is used.
